title: Quick-Fix Wilted Norwegian Pork Tacos
description: Funky, fluffy, quick-fix Norwegian dish featuring red chilli powder, lardons-render, and vegan-friendly options in a comal.
instructions: Season pork cubes with red chilli powder and salt. Set aside.
Heat lardons-render in a comal or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear pork cubes until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Add sliced red onion to the comal and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add chopped cilantro to the comal and stir to combine.
Warm corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble tacos by placing cooked pork and onion mixture onto tortillas.
Top with vegan sour cream, if desired, and serve with lime wedges.
Cook time will be shorter if using a skillet instead of comal.
This dish is quick to prepare and can be made with or without the lardons-render.
Lardons-render adds a rich, Norwegian flavor to the dish.
If using a skillet, be sure to not overcrowd the pan.
